records.issue_text: handleNewBooking.ts:~1080 calls evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars) which throws a TypeError when destinationCalendar is null (optional chaining doesn't help for null); should be evt.destinationCalendar = [...(evt.destinationCalendar ?? []), ...teamDestinationCalendars]
records.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the code sets `destinationCalendar` to an array or `null`, then does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. Optional chaining (`?.`) *does* short-circuit when the receiver is `null` or `undefined`, so this will not throw a TypeError when `destinationCalendar` is null; it will simply no-op. The finding misstates JS/TS optional chaining behavior.
